subject: [Final Project] Test Data Released + Important Format Requirement — Due 12/05: CS 4310: Intro Natural Language Process (2025 Fall)
body_redacted:
Hi Class,

We have released the final project test set. To make sure your submission is readable by our auto-grader, please pay attention to the following format requirements:

Submission format

* Submit one JSON file where each row corresponds to one test question.

* Each row must have an "output" field whose value is a string containing only the final answer (e.g., "output": "42").

* Please make sure the output string contains the final answer only, without any intermediate reasoning or tool traces.

How to generate

* We have prepared the starter script: generate_answer_template.py

* Replace the logic inside build_answers() to call your agent loop and return the final answer string for each question.

* Do not change the output schema or file format produced by the script.

Hard checks

* The script includes format validations. If your file fails these checks, you will receive a grade of 0.

Where to submit

* Upload your JSON output file on Canvas (Assignments → Final Project Submission).

Deadline: 12/05

Please let us know if you have any questions or run into any issues. Good luck!

Kevin

File Included: cs4310_final_project_submission.zip - 1.41 MB

subject: Course Wrap-up and Final Exam: CS 4370: Intro Computer-Aided Geom Desg (2025 Fall)
body_redacted:
Hello CS 4370ers,

On Wednesday we will review the mock final document and I am happy to discuss any material that is not clear.

All submissions must be uploaded to Canvas by Friday, Dec 5 at 11:50pm.

The final exam is on Wednesday, Dec 10 at 9:50am. It is a canvas quiz that requires Respondus Lockdown browser with a webcam.

Final exam instructions:

You have 75 minutes to complete this final exam. There are 40 questions.

If you see "^" in a question, this is indicates a superscript; for example "M^T", meaning M transpose. A subscript will be denoted by "_", as in a_1.
Questions will use the notation from the class slides, not MM notation (for array access).

This is a closed-book exam. You may have a blank piece of paper and pencil/pen with you during the exam.

If you have a question about the exam, answer the question as best as you can, and then email me afterwards.

Take your time and review your answers.

Elena Hart, PhD

[LINK_cca930cb]

subject: New: Grokking the Data Science Interview
body_redacted:
Plus Fenzo SAT Prep for the teen in your life

*Note: You are receiving this platform-related update because you have an active Educative account. If you wish to unsubscribe from product or other updates related to your account, you can do so anytime.

Sam,

We have two exciting new updates for you this week.

On Educative, there’s a new Grokking course for data science interviews, built around the mistakes that trip up even the strongest candidates. And if there’s a high schooler in your life — Fenzo now has a full preparation program for the digital SAT.

New on Educative

Grokking the Data Science Interview ([LINK_b01bd59d] )

Data science interviews reward the candidate who spots what’s wrong with an answer, like a join that double-counts revenue or a significant result that came from checking a test too often. Each lesson takes a real interview question, shows a common answer that falls short, then works through a stronger one along with the follow-ups an interviewer would ask. It runs from SQL and A/B testing through take-home assignments and product case questions, authored by our very own VP of Technical Content: Jordan Avery.

New on Fenzo

SAT Prep ([LINK_0840a696] )

Fenzo’s digital SAT program starts with a free diagnostic, which is like a shorter version of the real test. It then gives you a projected score on the 400 to 1600 scale and shows which content areas are costing points. From there, a study plan covers every skill on the test with short lessons and interactive practice. Once you've closed the gaps, you can progress to full-length mocks which mimic the digital SAT test environment.

Let us know what you think!

The Educative Team

educative.io ([LINK_5d551ea7] ) | fenzo.ai ([LINK_[LONG_NUMBER_REMOVED]a4] )
